facts.fact: L'Essor reports that under the amended electoral law the Administrative Commission automatically enrols voters from the biometric civil-status database, and electoral lists are revised annually from 1 October to 31 December, with errors corrected after computer processing of rectification tables.
facts.system: Liste electorale (Loi electorale 2022-019 as amended by Ordonnance 2024-022)

facts.fact: L'Essor reports the new electoral list is posted at the commune secretariat, embassy or consulate at the latest seven days before the vote.
facts.system: Liste electorale (Loi electorale 2022-019 as amended by Ordonnance 2024-022)

facts.fact: L'Essor reports the Administrative Commission enrols by right citizens holding a NINA and those in the biometric civil-status database with photo and fingerprints, and sends a copy of each list to the service managing that database.
facts.system: Liste electorale (Loi electorale 2022-019 as amended by Ordonnance 2024-022)
